title: Servers where every database has a successful backup
description: Use NOT EXISTS. Return servers that have at least one database and for which no database on that server lacks a successful backup. Return exactly one column: hostname. A server without databases must not be included. Sort by hostname ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT s.hostname
FROM servers AS s
hints: Separately prove that at least one database exists.
In the second condition, search for a server database for which no successful backup exists.
solution_explanation: Double NOT EXISTS expresses “every database has a successful backup”, while EXISTS excludes empty servers.
